title: Zscaler platform pillars: Zero Trust Exchange, Data Fabric for Security, Agentic SecOps and the customer-segment framing

prose.text: Zero Trust Exchange, Data Fabric for Security and Agentic SecOps are marketing pillars, not products; the customer-segment framing sits beside them.
Whether the platform is a unified policy and enforcement plane under every product is open {{gap:zte-plane}}.
{{dfs-what}} {{dfs-integrations}} {{dfs-targets}} Whether it is built on Avalor technology from a Zscaler acquisition is open {{gap:dfs-avalor}}.
{{dfs-exposure}} The Exposure Management products themselves are in [[aem.overview]], [[uvm.overview]], [[risk360.overview]] and [[easm.findings]].
{{agsecops-what}} {{agsecops-accuracy}} Whether Zscaler markets a 99.7% accuracy or 10× speed figure for it is open {{gap:agsecops-figures}}.
How Agentic SecOps sits across the suite is in [[portfolio.security-operations]].
The four-pillar segment framing is resolved {{gap:segment-pillars}}: the page has no Branch pillar, and it lists use cases instead {{zte-use-cases|ref}}. The B2B segment is in [[portfolio.b2b]].

checks.do: For a question about what the platform unifies, answer from the platform claims and do not extend them to a policy plane under every product.

For a question about Agentic SecOps accuracy, present the page's accuracy wording as what Zscaler markets or claims, not as measured fact, and do not cite the 99.7% figure, which the current page does not state.

zte-platform.statement: The Zero Trust Exchange page calls the Zero Trust Exchange a comprehensive, integrated platform that enables zero trust security and network transformation for all users, workloads, IoT/OT and B2B partners; it says Zscaler's proxy architecture enables full TLS/SSL inspection at scale and that one-to-one connections are brokered between users and applications based on identity, context and business policies.

quotes: The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™ is a comprehensive, integrated platform that enables zero trust security and network transformation for all users, workloads, IoT/OT, and B2B partners.
Based on the zero trust principle of least-privileged access, our unique proxy architecture enables full TLS/SSL inspection at scale.
One-to-one connections are brokered between users and applications based on identity, context, and business policies.

zte-model.statement: The Zero Trust Exchange page's Our Zero Trust Approach section lists Verify Identity, Determine Destination, Assess Risk and Enforce Policy.

quotes: Our Zero Trust Approach Verify Identity Determine Destination Assess Risk Enforce Policy

zte-signals.statement: The Zero Trust Exchange page's Assess risk entry says it uses AI to determine risk based on context, considering factors like user behavior, device posture, destination and content, third-party intel and more than 500 trillion daily signals.

quotes: ### Assess risk Use AI to determine risk based on context, considering factors like user behavior, device posture, destination and content, third-party intel, and more than 500 trillion daily signals.

zte-market.statement: The Zero Trust Exchange page's Recognition section says 50%+ of the Fortune 500 are Zscaler customers and cites Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for SSE.

quotes: ### 50%+ of the Fortune 500 are Zscaler customers
### Leader 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for SSE

zte-use-cases.statement: The Zero Trust Exchange page's Use cases section lists fast, secure and reliable access to the internet, SaaS and private apps for your people; securing workload communications and protecting data at rest within clouds and SaaS apps; IoT device discovery, zero trust connectivity for IoT/OT and privileged remote access to OT; and least-privileged access to SaaS and private apps for business partners.

quotes: Use cases ## Secure every step of your transformation journey Empower your people with fast, secure, and reliable access to the internet, SaaS, and private apps.
Secure your workload communications and protect data at rest within your clouds/SaaS apps.
Gain IoT device discovery, zero trust connectivity for IoT/OT, and privileged remote access to OT.
Extend least-privileged access to SaaS and private apps for your business partners.

dfs-what.statement: The Data Fabric for Security page says the Data Fabric aggregates and unifies data across all your security tools and business systems.

quotes: The Zscaler Data Fabric for Security aggregates and unifies data across all your security tools and business systems.

dfs-integrations.statement: The Data Fabric for Security page says it connects to 150 pre-built inbound and outbound integrations and that new connectors can be developed in one to two weeks on customer request.

quotes: Seamlessly connect to 150 pre-built inbound and outbound integrations. New connectors can be developed in one to two weeks on customer request.

dfs-targets.statement: The Data Fabric for Security page lists, with links to CTEM, Asset Exposure Management and Unified Vulnerability Management, a complete view of exposure to drive continuous threat exposure management programs, a complete, accurate and context-rich asset inventory, and accurate vulnerability analysis and risk-based prioritization.

quotes: Bring together all the data in your environment into an accurate, deduplicated, contextualized, and complete view of your exposure to drive continuous threat exposure management programs. Learn more about CTEM

Get a complete, accurate, and context-rich asset inventory to pinpoint misconfigurations and missing controls, and utilize automated workflows to close gaps. Learn more about Asset Exposure Management
Achieve accurate vulnerability analysis and risk-based prioritization with comprehensive asset visibility and context. Learn more about Unified Vulnerability Management

dfs-exposure.statement: The Data Fabric for Security page says the Data Fabric serves as the foundation for the Zscaler Exposure Management portfolio and powers several of the portfolio's products today, naming Asset Exposure Management and Unified Vulnerability Management.

quotes: This rich source of security data truth serves as the foundation for the Zscaler Exposure Management portfolio, powering feedback loops between products to drive even richer insights.

The Zscaler Data Fabric for Security powers several of the Exposure Management portfolio products today (Asset Exposure Management and Unified Vulnerability Management) and will become the foundation for many more in the near future.

agsecops-what.statement: The security operations page is headlined "Outpace AI-Driven Attacks with Agentic SecOps" and says Zscaler's AI agents, trained on over a decade of frontline SOC, MDR and threat hunting experience, provide triage, investigation, verdicts and response recommendations.

quotes: # Outpace AI-Driven Attacks with Agentic SecOps
Our AI agents, trained on over a decade of frontline SOC, MDR, and threat hunting experience, provide triage, investigation, verdicts, and response recommendations.

agsecops-accuracy.statement: The security operations page's FAQ says Zscaler AI agents are trained and tuned on over a decade of real-world threat hunting, MDR investigations and ThreatLabz research, and that, fusing insights from Red Canary MDR operations and 750+ billion daily Zero Trust Exchange transactions, they deliver high context accuracy and reliable remediation recommendations.

quotes: Zscaler AI agents are trained and tuned on over a decade of real-world threat hunting, MDR investigations, and ThreatLabz research.
Fusing insights from Red Canary MDR operations and 750+ billion daily Zero Trust Exchange transactions, these agents deliver high context accuracy and reliable remediation recommendations.

zte-plane.title: Whether the Zero Trust Exchange is a unified policy and enforcement plane under every product
zte-plane.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'The unified policy + enforcement plane underlying all products.' The ZTE marketing capture calls the platform comprehensive and integrated but does not describe a policy plane beneath every product.

segment-pillars.title: Whether Zero Trust for Users, Workloads, Branch and B2B are customer-segment pillars
segment-pillars.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Zero Trust for Users / Workloads / Branch / B2B: the four customer-segment pillars. Maps to product groupings rather than discrete SKUs.' No captured page names these four segments; the ZTE capture lists use cases, not segments.
segment-pillars.resolution: The ZTE page lists four use cases (claim zte-use-cases) and has no Branch pillar.

dfs-avalor.title: Whether the Data Fabric for Security is built on Avalor technology
dfs-avalor.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'The Data Fabric is powered by Avalor technology (Zscaler acquisition).' The earlier non-verbatim capture of the Data Fabric for Security page said this in a context section of its own; the current capture of the page does not mention Avalor.

agsecops-figures.title: Whether Zscaler markets a 99.7% threat accuracy figure or a 10× speed figure for Agentic SecOps
agsecops-figures.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'The platform's AI agents achieve "99.7% threat accuracy"' and 'Threats identified and stopped 10× faster.' Earlier non-verbatim captures of the security operations page said this; the current capture of the page gives neither figure and says the agents deliver high context accuracy (claim agsecops-accuracy).
